Topic 3.2: Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Create a simple collage picture using a variety locally materials for enjoyment
2. Appreciate their own and others work own and others work cupboard

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Create a simple collage picture using a variety locally materials for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create a simple collage picture using a variety locally materials for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate their own and others work own and others work cupboard
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate their own and others work own and others work cupboard. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to collect materials 1. Where do we get MAKING leaner should be able to: from their immediate environment materials for making TECHNIQUES 5 Lessons a) Identify materials used in
4. Show that you can: Create a simple collage picture using a variety locally materials for enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Collage MAKING TECHNIQUES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners to collect materials 1. Where do we get MAKING leaner should be able to: from their immediate environment materials for making TECHNIQUES 5 Lessons a) Identify materials used in
2. Guide learners into groups for collage? creating collage pictures for fun material sharing 2. What materials do you b) Create a simple collage picture
3. Insure learners observe safety work when using collage materials
4. Guide learners to appreciate their own and others work
5. Learners store finished items in the cupboard

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Create a simple collage picture using a variety locally materials for enjoyment
2. Appreciate their own and others work own and others work cupboard
